The "Telegram review-blocked judge decision" step would then log level=SUPPRESSED and exit 0 without sending the first CRITICAL page. Hardening suggestion (same fix): use "blocked\n\n" + _marker(...) at line 239 and line 271, 2 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
